Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A preventing or treating agent for glaucoma comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof, wherein the agent is administered in a therapeutically effective amount to prevent or treat glaucoma.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): A preventing or treating agent for ocular hypertension comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof, wherein the agent is administered in a therapeutically effective amount to prevent or treat ocular hypertension.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): A method for preventing or treating glaucoma wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered in a therapeutically effective amount.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): A method for preventing or treating ocular hypertension wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered in a therapeutically effective amount.
